{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection3","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericReferenceType_ListOfInt_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrash()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public List<int> Numbers { get; init; } = new();\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(appSource, baseReferences);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericReferenceType_ListOfReferencedGenericStruct_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrash()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference libRef = CompileLibrary(libSource, baseReferences);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> appReferences = baseReferences.Add(libRef);\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public List<Item<int>> Items { get; init; } = new();\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(appSource, appReferences);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericReferenceType_FromReferencedAssembly_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrash()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record RefItem<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial class RefClass<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference libRef = CompileLibrary(libSource, baseReferences);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> appReferences = baseReferences.Add(libRef);\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public RefItem<int> RefMember { get; init; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public RefClass<string> ClassMember { get; init; } = new();\n\n        [Key(3)]\n        public List<RefItem<int>> RefList { get; init; } = new();\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(appSource, appReferences);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<ImmutableArray<MetadataReference>> GetBaseReferencesAsync()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        return net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference CompileLibrary(string libSource, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references)\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver libDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        libDriver = libDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(libCompilation, out Compilation libOutput, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libGenDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult libRunResult = libDriver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.All(libRunResult.Results, result => Assert.Null(result.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(libGenDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        using MemoryStream ms = new();\n        var emitResult = libOutput.Emit(ms);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(ms.ToArray());\n    }\n\n    private static async Task AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(string appSource, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references)\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, result => Assert.Null(result.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n                || s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> outputDiagnostics = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n    }\n}\n"}
